newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 17 cents down on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 17 cents down on poor demand.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed 17 cents lower at 14.31 ringgit ($5.78)a kg after a weaker market in London sparked off initial selling.
Traders said there was an offer of 91 tonnes at the opening against bids of 23 tonnes. Final turnover was 81 tonnes, down from 135 on Friday, with buying from Europe and Malaysia.
The local price differential to London was $10 a tonne premium after holding a discount of $20 on Friday.
Traders expect the market to rebound to 14.50 before consolidating at this level in the near-term.
